pr_comment: Hi @luigidellaquila, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: Based on the conversion, the value should always be a datetime otherwise one ends with an invalid comparison.

Thank you @costin, I created a new issue about this https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/87500

About the check on `value`, actually the value is never involved in this comparison (not in this method at least), so there is no risk to have false positives due to it (on the other hand, false negatives are tolerated, eg. for date maths).
